result.reason: The redline satisfies the fallback position and partially achieves the preferred position: it expressly covers affiliates and contractors acting on Client's behalf and permits assignment to an M&A successor without consent. It does not address perpetual and irrevocable treatment for paid-up licences or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. The changes are targeted, preserve the existing use restrictions and commercial structure, and are professionally drafted. The margin comment does not cure the omitted preferred protections but accurately describes the operative changes.
